titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: A diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes sank near Ibiza, resulting in one death.
Seven people were injured, four critically, in an explosion at an oil refinery in Bangkok.
The United States announces new tariffs on multiple countries including China.
Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel and the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed.
EU leaders meet to discuss long-term budget and Ukraine.
